# Precision Tweezers Set of 3 With Leatherette Case

Shape, pluck, and detail with confidence using this three-piece stainless steel tweezer kit. Each tool has a frosted glitter finish and is well suited to precise eyebrow shaping and ingrown hair care.

## Three Tips for Every Task

Pick the right tip for the job. The blue flat tweezer grips broader hairs, the white pointed tweezer handles fine detail work, and the pink slanted tweezer makes angled eyebrow plucking easier. Together, they cover a range of grooming needs in one set.

## Built to Resist Rust

Crafted from stainless steel that resists corrosion and rust, these tweezers stay ready for routine grooming.

## Carry Them Anywhere

The included designer leatherette PVC case fits easily in a purse, bag, or drawer. It keeps all three tweezers together, so you can find them when you need them.

## Shop With Confidence

Many shoppers mention the set's sparkly style and value. Backed by a satisfaction guarantee with a full refund, this kit lets you try it with confidence. Add it to your cart today and build a grooming kit that's as stylish as it is functional.
